india_trends.title: Japanese stocks mixed as yields and oil prices rise
india_trends.summary: The Nikkei 225 fell 0.15% to 66,215, while the broader Topix gained 0.62% to 4,182. Japans 10-year government bond yield rose to around 3%, its highest level since 1996, as investors increasingly expect the Bank of Japan to raise interest rates this month.
